name: SAS
description: Deep neural networks have achieved impressive performance across a wide range of tasks, but this success often comes with substantial computational and storage costs due to large-scale training data. Dataset distillation addresses this challenge by constructing compact yet informative datasets that enable efficient model training while maintaining downstream performance. However, most existing approaches primarily emphasize matching data distributions or downstream training statistics, with limited attention to preserving high-level semantic information in the distilled data.
